cwd.description: Optional working directory used when path is empty or relative. Relative cwd values are resolved from the configured workspace; absolute cwd values are used as provided. Use an empty string for the configured workspace.

path.description: The directory or file path to search in. Relative paths are resolved from cwd. Use an empty string to search cwd. Matching file paths are returned as absolute paths.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against. Supports recursive ** patterns such as **/*.go and src/**/*.ts.
